details: Contradicted by the trivial two-concept class: proper stable labeled compression is 1, whereas co-VC dimension is 2.
proof: For the two constant concepts on a two-point domain, retaining one labeled example gives a proper stable labeled compression scheme, so the compression value is 1. The two traces form a hollow 2-star (the two mixed labelings are absent), so co-VC dimension is 2. Hence the stated universal inequality is false.
name: Proper Stable Labeled Sample Compression / co-VC dimension
